Class TitleRevealAnimator

java.lang.Object

    • startOnce

      public static void startOnce(javafx.scene.control.Label label, int stepMs, int flickerOffsetMs, double flickerProb)
      Starts the title reveal animation on the given label with custom settings.

      The animation reveals the text character by character, with a random flicker effect. It ensures the animation is only played once per label instance.

      Parameters:
      label - the label to animate.
      stepMs - the time in milliseconds between each character reveal.
      flickerOffsetMs - the time in milliseconds before the reveal to start flickering.
      flickerProb - the probability (0.0 to 1.0) of a flicker occurring.
